episode.episode: 7-15-26 - Hour 4 - If BYU defeats Notre Dame and Utah will they go 12-0 this season?
episode.showDescription: Cougar Sports with Ben Criddle (@criddlebenjamin) keeps you up-to-date on all things BYU Sports. We not only cover football & basketball, but we dive into recruiting, baseball, soccer, and more. For insight that you can't get anywhere else, tune into 103.9/ 98.3 FM. Monday-Friday from 2-6 PM MST. Follow us on social media @espnthefan & interact with us using #ESPNTheFan.
episode.episodeDescription: Ben Criddle talks BYU sports every weekday from 2 to 6 pm. transcript_window.text: Yeah.
A hundred percent.
Um, but, and, and again, West Point is unique.
I mean, it is not everybody.
BYU operated as an independent for a long time, very successfully.
And so so there is a blueprint out there.
And again, you know, in the midst of this World Cup conversation, there there has to maintain opportunities.
And sometimes scholarships are enough for Olympic sports student athletes to still be able to continue to develop.

develop um and you know the answer is out there and if nothing else has come from this this mess that we're in great conversations have been had outside the box thinking is taking place and and student athletes who are putting their bodies on the line and generating revenue for institutions are now getting
a cut of that i think those are all great things football wise where do we stand And Sonny Dykes received the extension.
He's a fantastic football mind, very impressed with him over the years.
Where do we stand in football?
Well, it's hard to tell.
You know, you used to be able to see who's returning who, and you had film.
And, you know, there schools that have 60, 70 new faces every year now.
So it's hard to tell where we stand in regards to our competition.
I know that Coach Dykes is really excited about the group that we've had.
I think we have added some key pieces and not only are they talented athletes, they seem to fit in really well from a team chemistry, you know, character standpoint.
And so that's a great starting point.
Now, of course, we all know you've got to stay healthy and you've got to have great schemes.
We've got a new offensive coordinator that I'm really excited about.
I think we'll be a little bit more simplified.
But, you know, in college football, you know, we talked about this matchup.
I was really excited to come out there last year to Provo and thought we were going to have a really competitive game.
And it sadly really wasn't.
And that's what that's what you get when you're dealing with 19 to 22 year old kids.
